english.meaning: to invite someone to a banquet or drinks, such as a wedding banquet
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Lots of people are inviting me to wedding banquets this month. Are you?
exampleSentences.traditional: 我呢今個月呢好多人請飲啊，你係唔係啊？
